reason: I already find out what's happening from stories and friends' reposts without lifting a finger. Downloading an app and opening it on purpose is exactly the kind of thing I never do, and it will want my location and notifications.
objection: Another app to install, another thing asking for permissions, when Instagram already brings events to me for free while I scroll.
would_change_my_mind: If the app's events showed up inside my Instagram feed anyway — like friends reposting a 'who else is going' story from it — and I saw people I actually know going, I'd install it to grab a ticket once.
